English: Reestablish the Kipchak Khanate

The Tatar states are weak and fragmented. For far too long we have underestimated the Russians and the fall of the Qazan Khanate proved this. The realization of this threat and the shifting balance of power has convinced our great Khan to reconcile with his old Tatar rivals. All the Khans have agreed to reestablish the Altin Urda under our banner. The Rus' shall burn!
Reestablish the Kipchak Khanate

The Tatar states were weak and fragmented. For far too long we have underestimated the Russians and the fall of the Qazan Khanate proved this. We need to overthrow our old rivals and reassert our dominance over the Russians once again. Long live the Khan!
Reestablish the Kipchak Khanate
The Tatar states were weak and fragmented. After decades of struggle and decline, we have managed to subdue the Tatar Steppes. Now it is time to reclaim Batu Khan's legacy.
End the Qazan Raids
For centuries, the raids originating from Qazan have devastated our lands. It is time to finally bring an end to the Tatar Yoke!
Take control in Novgorod
The Republic of Novgorod has been a part of our sphere of influence for centuries, but with increasing Russian nationalism we should integrate them further into our realm.
Integrate Estland

Estland has been a dominion of Sweden since the 16th century, but with the increasing threat of Russian unification, our control of the Northern Baltics is in danger. We must sacrifice Estonian autonomy to secure the region's stability!
Integrate Livland

Livland has been a dominion of Sweden since the 16th century, but with the increasing threat of Russian unification, our control of the Northern Baltics is in danger. We must sacrifice Livonian autonomy to secure the region's stability!
Integrate Ingria

Ingria has been a dominion of Sweden since the 16th century, but with the increasing threat of Russian unification, our control of the Northern Baltics is in danger. We must sacrifice Ingrian autonomy to secure the region's stability!
Subjugate the Nogay Khanate
The foolish Khan of Nogay has refused our offer. We need to subjugate him by the sword to save the Tatars from Russian expansionism!
Nogay accepts our offer
The Khan of Nogay has accepted our offer. The Russians won't stand a chance against a united Steppe!
Centralize the Khanate
Now that the Russian threat has been dealt with, our rule is unchallenged. It is time to formally unite the Khanate!
Subjugate the Qashliq Khanate
The foolish Khan of Qashliq has refused our offer. We need to subjugate him by the sword to save the Tatars from Russian expansionism!
Qashliq accepts our offer
The Khan of Qashliq has accepted our offer. The Russians won't stand a chance against a united Steppe!
Astrakhan accepts our offer
The Khan of Astrakhan has accepted our offer. The Russians won't stand a chance against a united Steppe!
Avenge Qazan!

The Russian conquest of Qazan was extremely brutal. It depopulated the once rich region of the Upper Idel, with thousands of Qazanis fleeing their home and even more getting killed by Skobelev's troops - not to mention the ruthless execution of the Khan and his entire family. It is our duty, now that the Steppe stands united, to liberate Qazan!
Subdue Yugra

The fur traders of the Yugrian wastes were able to remain independant by opportunistically switching alliances between the Tatars and Russians. Now that we are dominating both Russia and the Steppe, we are in a position to assume direct control over their valuable resources.
Subdue the Sayan Tribes

After having conquered Yugra, the cold wastes of Siberia are almost free to grab. The only thing holding us back is the influencial position of the Oirat Khagnate in Tuva and the Baikal. The conquest of the Sayan Tribes will increase our influence in the region.
Annex Tuva
Our increased influence in Tuva allows us to further integrate the region. This act, however, will force the Oirats to respond.
Take control over Buryatia
The Oirat control in Central Siberia has collapsed. We need to fill this vacuum of power.
Take control in the Daur Khanate
The Oirat control in the North has collapsed. We need to fill this vacuum of power.
The Jurchen Conflict

The momentum of the Pacific Push still hasn't slowed down. A lot of Tatar tribes still search for their own, new, suitable plot of land. Many of these tribes now violated the territory of the Jurchen, a tributary of the Great Shun. This needs to be settled so that further conflict can be avoided.
Subdue the Sakhalar

The semi-nomadic Sakhalar originally fled from the Mongols in the 13th century. They now live in the rich basins of the Lena, Aldan and Vilyuy Rivers and are fabled as horse breeders. But now they pose the last obstacle in our Push to the Pacific - their subjugation would not only give us access to their skills, but also their rich fur market.
The Pacific Coast

Our troops have finally reached the long-awaited coastline, but our forces met resistance from the local population. Even though our troops were successful, the areas of Kamchatka and Chukchia are now almost uninhabitated. Nevertheless, we should formally announce the annexetion of these territories!
The Conquest of the North

The land of the Tymyr was thought to be only a part of Siberlar folklore, but with our conquest, multiple reports have told us about a group of people far in the north speaking a familiar sounding language. We should use this to justify the conquest of these regions!
Claim the Northern Caucasus

While the Northwestern Caucasus has been under our control for centuries, the Northeast has been part of the Timurid Empire. However, the recent collapse of the Iranian behemoth has left the entire Caucasus in turmoil. Local khanates, tribes and various Christian principalities are all that is left. This is the perfect opportunity to not only establish a formidable natural border, but also to integrate the Turkic tribes living in these regions!
Claim Qasim

The Tatars of Qasim originated from the lands of the Golden Horde, but during their collapse, thousands fled. The Hetmans of Ryazan and Kursk offered them refuge. In exchange, they were ordered to protect the border regions and as time passed, most of them even converted to Christianity. Now that the Khanate is united once again, we should reincorporate our lost brethern!

Recreate the Bulghar Khanate

The Bulghars once lived in what is now Qazan. While their origins aren't known, many think that the Chuvash are their direct decendants or are at least their linguistic relatives. As we have now established a dominant position in both Inner and Outer Qazan, we are able to reclaim their lost legacy!
Build the White Sea Canal!

The Anglo-Nordic control over the Baltic Sea still poses a risk for trade and conflict. If we were to connect the Wyg with Lake Onega, we would be able to circumvent their tariffs, while at the same time making use of the Northeast Passage. This would strengthen the regions of Karelia and Kola.
Assert Dominance over Perm
In order to secure our dominance over the region, the lords of Perm must recognize our benevolent rule.
Control the Cossacks
While the Qazani Raids are over, the tribes of Astrakhan and Crimea still threaten our influence in the Steppe. With the support of the Cossacks we would be able to counter their raids.
Proclaim the Tsardom of Russia

Now that we control a realm stretching from the Urals to the Steppes, we stand in a position to proclaim the the Tsardom of Russia. While this title will probably not be recognized by the other Great Powers, this will certainly support our Pan-Russian ambitions.
Unite Russia
Reform the Oblast System

The Oblast System was the result of years of feudalism and careful balancing of power between the different landlords and the crown. Such medieval traditions only hinder our nation - there is no way forward but to abolish them.
Claim The Legacy of Kyivan Rus'

The Kings of Ruthenia claim their legacy from the Kyivan Rus', which used to rule the lands from Kyiv to Novhorod. As their direct decendants, we should annouce to the world our ambition to rule over the lands that are rightfully ours.

The Russian states have been disunited ever since the collapse of the Kyivan Rus'. However, now that we have managed to build a power base and establish ourselves as the leading force of Russian unification, it is time to reclaim our lost glory and, after centuries, shake off the Tatar Yoke!
Restore the Rus'

The Russian states have been disunited ever since the collapse of the Kyivan Rus'. However, now that we have managed to build a power base and establish ourselves as the leading force of Russian unification, it is time to reclaim our lost glory and, after centuries, shake of the Tatar Yoke!
Reunite the Kingdom of Imereti!

The Kingdom of Imereti was an independent state ever since the dissolution of Georgia. However, the subjugation and vassalization by the Timurids left the Kingdom in ruins. Local nobles used this opportunity to declare independence from Kutaisi. We need to restore Imereti, and ultimately reclaim Georgia!
Restore Georgia

The Kingdom of Georgia was once a pan-Caucasian power, but countless invasions of the Timurids and the plague left the nation in despair and anarchy. Ultimately, this resulted in its fracturing into four polities - Imereti, Kakheti, Samtskhe and Kartli. Only Imereti was able to withstand the Timurids, far until the early 18th century. If we were able to unite these four states under our rule, we could reassert ourselves as the Lords of the Caucasus!
Claim Alvuania!

Alvuania (or Albania) was a medieval kingdom in what is now Arran. Together with Georgia and Armenia, they were the first nations to convert to Christianity, but today most of the inhabitants assimilated into Persian culture and converted to Islam. Nonetheless, smaller Christian Alvuani communties still exist all along the Kura River. We must protect them by integrating them into our realm!
Claim Armenia

The Armenians can be found all over the Caucasus. However, their main settlement area is near Lake Van and in the Rum province. We should instrumentalize their scattered settlements and expand our claims!
Reclaim Sochi

The city of Sochi once was part of the Kingdom of Abkhazia, which got integrated into Georgia in the 11th century. The city itself was part of the Georgian state until the 15th century, when Georgia was dismantled. Now that we rebuild the state, we should lay claims to the city!
Control the Dar-i Alan Gorge

The Dar-i Alan (or Darial) Gorge is the only bigger pass through the Greater Caucasus. The area is inhabitated by the Ossetians, who, for the most part, are Orthodox Christians. It is in our interest to claim both sides of this pass!
Restore the Alanian Kingdom

The Kingdom of Alania was a major power in the North Caucasus in the Middle Ages. During the Mongol Invasion, the Kingdom was destroyed and many Alanians fled into the safety of the mountains - while others joined the Mongols. As we are now a free state again, we should reclaim our once lost lands!
Claim Greater Armenia

Greater Armenia, or “Mets Hayk'“, originally referred to Armenian Kingdom in the Armenian Highlands. However, since the Middle Ages, the term was used to distinguish it from Cilicia, the last independent western Armenian state. Now is the time to instrumentalize the term to lay claim on the a unified Armenia, reaching from Artsakh to Cilicia!
Join Armenia
Now that a new Armenian state has been established, we should unify with our brethern.
Become Armenia
With the Azeri khanates defeated and Eastern Armenia reclaimed, we are in the position to proclaim a new Armenian state!
Claim Eastern Armenia

Ever since the end of Bagratids, Armenian statehood was fragile, with only two minor Armenian domains: Cilicia and Khachen. Of these, only we have survived until now, even though not entirely independent. However, the recent and unexpected collapse of the Timurids changes this. While we are now a sovereign state, new threats arose - the now unrestrained Azeri khanates. We should utilize this new situation and quickly reclaim Eastern Armenia!
Reunite Iran

The Timurid Collapse left the Iranian Highlands in turmoil. Multiple warlords, pretenders and republicans all claim to be the rightful rulers over Iran. However, we have managed to defeat all of them and reunify central and western Iran. The next obvious step would be to adopt the title Shahanshah - King of Kings.
Reclaim Iraq-e Arabi

Iraq was an integral part of Iranian empires and dynasties for centuries. Baghdad and her predecessors acted as the capital of both the Sassanid and Arsacid empires. Furthermore, the regions spiritual importance in the form of the holy sites in Najaf, as well as its fertile and strategic position, emphasize our vital interest in this region.
Reclaim Kordestan

The eastern Kurdish tribes inhabit both sides of the mighty Zagros mountains, a barrier that has protected the Iranian heartland for ages. However, local chieftains only answered to the Shahanshah himself. Due to the recent collapse of the Timurid Empire, these chieftains have united in a federation-like state and now are threatening neighbouring powers. We need to subdue them once again!
Reclaim the Caucasus

Following the Timurid Collapse, southern Caucasus fell into chaos and anarchy. Local Turkic warlords fight for dominace over the region, while in the east both the Talysh and the Tats have declared independent states. We need to restore order!
Stop the Balochi Raids

The Balochi tribes, once dependent on Timurid rule, are now laying waste to the fragile ports in the desert-like region of the Hormuzgan. Since we have managed to subdue the Abdali Afghan tribes in eastern Khorasan, we should finally turn our attention to these trouble makers!
Reclaim Eastern Khorasan

The region of Eastern Khorasan was one of the first areas to rebel against Timurid rule. However, the Afghan confederation quickly collapsed due to tribal rivalries between the western Abdali tribes and the eastern Ghilzai tribes. We should use this opportunity to restore order in Khorasan!
Unite the Turkomans

The Azeris, or Eastern Turkomans, migrated into Arran and Azarbayjan in the 11th century. Due to extensive contact with the locals, most of them became Persianized. However, many of the non-assimilated tribes still played a major role in the Caucasus and Eastern Anatolia, mainly as loyal elite soldiers and conquerors, thus maintaining a military and political position in the area. We should unite these tribes under our banner!
Conquer Anatolia

The Turks of Anatolia have been disunited ever since Timur's Anatolian Invasion. The once mighty Ottomans errupted into a civil war, ultimately leading to their demise and subjugation by the Bulgarians, while the remaining tribes joined Timur. Now that Timurid control has collapsed we should use this opportunity to unite with our western brethren! Claim the Mashriq

Mashriq, or “the East“, was once the centre of the Islamic world, but, especially Iraq, could never recover from the devastating Mongol invasion. The Timurid Collapse led has to the creation of an decentralized and weak Arab state. With the united power of our Anatolian brethern we shall impose our rule on both Iraq and Syria!

Invade Iraq

Invade Iran
Now that the Kurds are subdued and Iraq is under our control, the gates to Iran are open. We should use the current turmoil there to establish our own mighty rule!
Unite Rum
Now that we have driven out the Timurids from our lands, we shall strike the Bulgarians too. Anatolia shall be unified under the restored banner of a Muslim Rome!
Unite the Northern Caucasus
We should unite northern Caucasus to protect our people from forgein powers!
Proclaim the Shamkhalate
Now that we are free from the Timurids, we should reinstitute our dominance over the Avars and Dargins!
Unite Daghestan
No longer shall the sons and daughters of the mountain be subject to foreign rule! Let us proclaim a new, united and strong independent Daghestan!
Claim Mawarannahr

Mawarannahr - or Transoxiana - is the last center of Timurid rule, with a lot of Uzbek tribesmen still loyal to them. We should integrate this territory to not only end Timurid rule once and for all, but also to establish a proper buffer area against Kyrgyz raids!
Subdue the Afghans
While the Abdali Afghans were already subjugated, the Ghilzai are still vassals of the Sayyids. We should push further east to establish control over the Hindu Kush and Sulaiman Range passes!
Reclaim Khwarezm

Khwarezm once was a center of Iranian literature and culture. However, the Mongol invasions devastated the local population, leading to a slow assimilation into Turks and Persians. We should reintegrate this region into Iran, as it was the origin of the last local, Iranian dynasty!
Push to the Upper Euphrates
Let us secure our rule by pushing up the Euphrates.
Proclaim Iranzamin
We have managed to establish our rule in all of Greater Iran - reaching from the Euphrates to the Hindu Kush and from the Aral Sea to the Persian Gulf.
Unite the Uzbeks
We have managed to defeat the other Uzbek tribes and khanates. It's about time to officially unite the Uzbeks!
Embrace the Uzbek Identity
Our empire has collapsed and the Iranians have abandoned us. It is clear that our future now lays within the Turanian highlands.
Unite Turan

The tribes of Turan have always been fighting each other and especially since the Timurid collapse the situation has been most tumultuous. But since we have managed to subdue all the other tribes it's only appropiate to adopt the title of rulers of Turan!
Claim Greater Turan

Even though the northern Kyrgyz steppes technically aren't part of Turan, they are inhabitated by our kinsmen nonetheless. Since we are now considered a regional power we should assume control over the region!
Claim Greater Kurdistan

The recent modernization of our nation has led to a more centralized bureaucracy. European ideas like nationalism spread like wildfire. Many students and intellectuals demand a more aggressive policy against the Turks to the west who have been oppressing the central anatolian Kurds. We should definitely integrate them into our nation!
Proclaim the second Median Empire

Now that our western brothers are freed from Turkish oppression, we should lay claim to the ancient region of Media. Even though the Adari, Tats, Talysh, Gilaki and Mazandaranis don't consider themselves to be Kurdish, they are most definitely closely related to us.
Claim Iraq
To secure our rule, we shall claim the fertile region between the Euphrates and the Tigris.
Restore the Serbian Empire

Once the hegemon of the Balkans, the ancient, noble and most puissant Empire of the Serbs has fallen victim to the machinations of the Hungarians, Bulgarians, Bosnian peasants and clearly everyone else that has ever done as wrong. Well, no more! Now we stand the precipice of history as we rise from the ashes like a mighty Slavic phoenix - the spirits of Milosh Obilich, Tsar Lazar and Tsar Stefan proclaiming in unison: God is a Serb!
Unite Hellas

For years, Hellas has been divided among several kingdoms or occupied by foreigners at the pleasure of our common enemies. To unite the Greek lands under a sole flag and one ruler is our only way to greatness.
Restore the Kingdom of Poland

The kingdom that the Piasts once worked so hard to reunify is now divided and without a king. We must strive to unite the Polish people and create a Polish nation to take the place of the kingdom that once was.
Call for West Slavic Unity
For centuries our nation has been the pinnacle of western Slavic culture. It is only fitting that we should declare the idea of a united west Slavic state to the other powers.
Restore the Kingdom of Lotharingia

As the new claimants to the Lotharingian crown, we draw our legitimacy by appealing to the legacy of Charlemagne and Lothair. Under our patronage, the exploits of our ancestors have once again become common knowledge, both among our own people and throughout the courts of Europe.
Unite the City States of the Swahili Coast

Ever since the collapse of the Kilwa Sultanate, which dominated the region for centuries, the Swahili Coast has been disunified and thrown into chaos. The many city states have fought for control over the prosperous slave, ivory and gold trade. However, no Sultan has managed to reestablish the old glory of Kilwa and the region fell deeper into decline with the appearance of firearms, as well as the increasing Egyptian presence. We must reunite the Swahili States under our rule!
Push into Outer Tanganyika

The old trade routes which ran along the many rivers of East Africa have been in decline for a long time. Yet, these old trading stations and settlements could help us, atleast in name, to control the adjecent areas. Combined with the adventures of “Muuzaji Mkubwa“, this expansion could reignite our trading power!
Topple the Merina Kingdom

The kings of Magadascar have long been eyeballing the important trading hub of Mahajanga and a lot of minor skirmishes already happend in the border regions. We have to eliminate this threat and while doing so, claim the authority over the island!
Establish a modern school system

Our old schools simply cannot hold up with modern schools and even the Madrassas were only available for the elites. Now that we control a huge amount of land it has also become important to spread the usage of the Swahili language. By funding these modern schools, we can ensure that these institutions can spread both our faith and our language!
Reestablish the Adal Sultanate

The Adal Sultanate once was the strongest Muslim power in the Horn of Africa and fought the Ethiopian empires for centuries. However, similar to their Christian counterparts, isolationism, corruption and fragmentation lead to the decline of the Sultanate. Now, multiple smaller Somali, Afar, Aussa and Oromo states fight for regional dominance, while at the same time the new King of Shewa is eager to reunite Ethiopia. If we can reunite the Muslims under our rule and destroy the Kingdom of Shewa, we could establish ourselves once again as the rulers of this region!
The Pan-Cushitic Movement

The Cushitic peoples have long suffered from domination by outside powers: the Ethiopians, Arabs, Bantus, the Swahilis and so on. With the arrival of the European ideas of nationalism, many modern-minded intellectuals now propose that we should follow a more aggressive stance towards countries that actively oppress our Cushitic brethren. While this agenda will most likely decrease relations with our neighbours, it'll also give us the opportunity to establish ourselves as the dominant force in Eastern Africa!
Build New Jerusalem

Now that we have united Ethiopia under our rule once more, we should build a new capital. This new metropolis shall serve as a centre for new Jewish settlers and for the native population of Ethiopia.
The Kingdom of Solomon

For centuries, the Ethiopians have been ruled by dynasties originating from the House of Solomon. Now that we have managed to end the Era of Princes and establish ourselves as the hegemonic power in Ethiopia, we shall remind the world of our Solomonic legacy!
A New Capital for the Sultanate
Now that the Swahili coast is once more united, we should build a new capital to emphasize the unity of our people!
Complete the Conquest of Tanganyika
With new technologies becoming available for us, as well as the growing interest of Europeans in African matters, we can and should increase our influence within Eastern Africa.
Claim the Legacy of the Chwezi Empire

The Chwezi Empire was a mythical empire in the oral traditions of our people and existed before the collapse of the kingdoms of the Great Lakes. Now that we have subdued all of the other rulers we can claim their legacy!
Leave The German Confederation

Since the formation of our great state, the lingering question among our populace has been that of membership in the German Confederation. We sincerely believe that our state deservers more than to be a mere associated nobody of a foreign power - we are our own people, and so we shall remain our own nation!
Invite Frisia
Our federation is glorious and its fame has been felt through the world. Surely the Frisians would be most overjoyed to share in our jubilance!
Launch the Masovian Uprising

Ever since the Cleaving of the Polish Lands, the Duchy of Masovia had fought tooth and nail to secure its political independence from the rest of Poland. Now, thanks to the efforts of the Bohemians, this separation is hardly visible, and our struggle for independence may come true only through military action.
Hej Kto Polak Na Bagnety!

Today is a day of blood and glory: let it be a day of resurrection! Gazing at France's rainbow, The White Eagle launches into flight. Inspired by the sun of July, He calls to us from above: "Arise, o Poland, break your chains, Today is a day of your victory or death!"
Economic Reforms of Prince Drucki-Lubecki

Prince Drucki-Lubecki, commonly nicknamed "The Small Prince" is a prominent politician in the Duchy of Masovia. His economic policies of interventionism, as well as plans to abolish tariffs between Bohemia and Masovia, may present a great opportunity to enrich our small dominion greatly.
Istenem, Egyseg, Fuggetlenseg!

The Revolutions of past years in Germany and the subsequent reformation of states around us has proven that remnants of any feudal administration are a great weakness to the state. Therefore, to preserve our integrity and unity, under the guidance of Almighty God, our Apostolic Majesty decrees that the following laws shall pass into immediate effect...
Become Croatia
Free of Hungarian yoke, we can finally govern ourselves freely.
Join Croatia
Become one with the existing Croatian state.
Become Siebenburgen
Free of Hungarian yoke, we can finally accomplish the dream of our ancestors of a united Transylvanian state under German leadership.
Construct the Corvinus Line

Many wars between Hungary and Bohemia have begun by a northern invasion deep along the Danube. In response, Hungarian rulers have tried to fortify the river and the border with Bohemia so as to delay or stop possible invasions, though these plans were never really successful. Presently, our general staff has proposed the idea of a construction of what they call the “Corvinus Line“ - a series of forifications along the Danube river, named after a great Hungarian general who soundly defeated the Bohemians on the field of battle.
Kunsag Industry Boom

The Kunsag area is rich in many mining and industrial resources - no wonder then that over the years it has become one of our most important regions. We should embrace this “industrial revolution“ happening there and reap its benefits to the fullest extent.
Create the Kingdom of Dacia

The struggles between Hungary and Bulgaria have often left the smaller polities in-between in unfortunate positions. Now that we control both the Sziretság and the Pecsenyföld, we should unite the two to form a stronger ally against out opponents!
Claim The Halych Rus'

For centuries, the Halych Rus' and its pathetic constitutional government have tried to secure its independence from Hungary with the help of Bohemia, but no more! We shall end their state once and for all.
Einn Kongur Einn Kvnthri!

The North Sea Empire, ever since it first came into existence in 1013 and later became reforged by Harald the Conqueror in 1066 after the Battle of Stamford Bridge, has been plagued by civil wars and matters of sucession. The Empire has split apart many times. Eventually though, a system would develop where the Three Kingdoms - Denmark, Norway and Jorvik, could operate relatively independently of each other while still using the same treasury. Later consolidations of the Empire would result in further integrations of the Three Kingdoms. The establishment of the Komingstaor - an imperial parliment, by Olaf the Wise in 18th century, has paved the way for a new wave of integration reform ideas that are still alive and well in the Anglo-Norse Society. These ideas are represented by the liberal factions, calling for removal of all feudal remnaints and for embracing a federal style of administration under the guidence of the king. Their slogan is "Einn Kongur, Einn Kvnthri" - "One King, One Country".
Protect Frisia

The Frisians have always been a close ally of ours against the Saxons. Its poor people have for long been plagued by invasions from their neighbours, leading to attempts to incorporate the state into our Confederation under equal laws - most notably by King Olaf the Wise in 1729. The offer was, however, declined, due to the fear of marginalisation of the state in such a union. Now though, with the Saxon menace growing in strength, perhaps we should again reach an agreement with the Frisians?
Create the Nordic Monetary Union

Although each member kingdom of the North Sea Empire uses the same treasury, each uses a different kind of currency. If we aim to centralise the confederation, we should perhaps create a proper monetary union to pave the way for use of a single currency in the future.

Nevertheless, with the armed conflict brought to an end we can begin a new era of rebuilding, reconciliation and prosperity.
Pacify the Tribes of the Siyaj

With our hands finally free after defeating our rivals in the Civil War, we can now turn our attention to the wild frontier to our North-West. Humri colonists have named it the Siyaj, the Enclosure, so called by its characteristic landscape of savannah delimitated by closed-canopy groves. A confederation of native tribes led by a strongman named Tamo stands in our way, but his puny military forces should be but a small obstacle in our path to national greatness.
Construct Forts in the Siyaj

The ongoing partisan struggle in the Siyaj is thwarting all Humri attempts to establish an effective administration of the area and exploit its resources. Although the natives led by Chief Tamo don't dare to engage the Humri forces in the open plains, they reign supreme in the closed-canopy forests, where they regularly ambush patrols and supply columns with great effect. If we are to turn the situation around, our strategy needs to change - al-Humr administration will be centered around newly-built forts, far beyond the means of the natives to attack, and travel between these protected islands will be carried out with armed convoys, preferrably avoiding trails running through dense forest.
Push into the Outer Siyaj

With the Inner Siyaj finally pacified, we can set our eyes further to the interior of the continent, to the very geographical limits of the Siyaj. The Kayapo and Sherente tribes inhabiting the area possess none of the high-level organisation that allowed Chief Tamo to successfully oppose us and, being separated by thousands of kilometres, are not going to be able to cooperate in a joint struggle. We must seize the opportunity while it's still ripe.
A New Capital for Al-Humr

For years, proposals have been thrown to build a brand-new capital for Al-Humr. The current capital city, Madkhal al-Balad, carries a historical baggage tied to the slave trade, being the traditional entry point for slaves coming from West Africa. Moreover, with the conquest of the Siyaj the control of our Western frontier is becoming harder to monitor from the Atlantic coast. We will build a new capital, named Madinat al-Sha'b, in the Siyaj, the current geographic centre of our realm, therefore making a clean break with the darker side of Humri history and providing a regionally neutral location from which to administer the disparate domains of al-Humr.
Subsidise the Siyaji Primary Sector

The building of a new capital, Madinat al-Sha'b, in the Siyaj has brought an influx of settlers inland and thus the possibility of modernising the economy of the savannah. The Siyaj is rich in mineral resources, ranging from diamonds and noble metals to coal with which to fuel our burgeoning industry. The open plains are ideal for cattle grazing and, with the help of modern agricultural techniques, part of it can also be earmarked for cereal production. Finally, the region is also suited for growing hemp to support the already economically important textile production.
Propose a Union with Al-Tufunawa

The Amassunayi and Humri peoples are close brothers, both descending from Moroccan colonisation of the New World. Nevertheless, whereas al-Humr has risen to greatness since Independence was won, the Amassunayi state, al-Tufunawa, has progressively slided into irrelevance. Already al-Tufunawa is economically dependant on al-Humr to survive, and its frontiers are protected by a military pact with al-Humr. It is clear that it would be in the best interest of the Amassunayi if the last vestiges of frontiers between the two brother peoples were torn down and they joined together in a union state. A proposal will be sent to Al-Tufunawa.
Unite Abralmuhit

We are one step closer towards dominating Abralmuhit, the great southern continent, after the incorporation of Al-Tufunawa. Our Amassunayi brothers are our close cultural kin, but were misguided by selfish powermongers into resisting our rule. Nevertheless, now that the Tufunawa state has been dismantled there no longer exist any barriers to separate our peoples.
Initiate the Amassuna Conference

Our recent integration of the Tufunawa lands into Al-Humr has opened up exploration into the vast Amassunian frontier. So far, the dense rainforests of the Amassuna have only been seldomly penetrated by Humri missionaries trying to spread Islam to the natives, but the region's potentially vast and largely untapped resources still need prospecting. We are not the only polity bordering the Amassuna Basin, however - the Incas in the west and the Sallians in the north also lay claim to this territory. We should send them invitations to a conference to partition the Amassuna with the purpose of drawing formal borders - to our favour, of course.
Reject the Amassuna Protocol

The Amassuna Conference divided a great expanse of unclaimed territory between our realms, Sallia and Al-Humr, with the lion's share going to Al-Humr. We must denounce this so-called conference as a sham and enforce our claims to the Amassuna Basin, regardless of what Protocol might have been accorded between the Humri and Sallian diplomats.
Unite the Chaku

The great plains of the Chaku have for a long time been disputed between the Kamichingan, Abipon and Mbaya peoples. Now that we have achieved dominance over our neighbours, it is time to finally end the internecine squabbles and pacify the region, lest our infighting entice foreigners to invade and colonise the Chaku.
Establish Control Over the Zerafshan Valley

The Zerafshan Valley is a sparsely populated and rugged place, dominated by local highland Tajik and Yaghnub tribes - controlling this area has always been a major challenge. However, with increasing advances in administration and the development of the state this once troublesome area should be tamed easily.
Dealing with the Rustamids

Out of the anarchy of the Timurid Succession Crisis, a messianic figure called Rustam emerged from the Zoroastrian community in Yazd, claiming to be the reincarnation of the legendary Wahram Shah. However, with our increasing control over the Western and Central parts of the Iranian Highlands, we are now in a position to challenge this emerging cult. While we could simply force our will on the people living there, it is certain that Zoroastrians, who gained political power and privilege for the first time in over ten centuries, might not be willing to accept our rule.
Subjugation of Khorasan
Khorasan has been the center of Iranian culture for the last few centuries. Restoring control over the area would be of great importance.
The Caspian Campaign

The Caspian Campaign was an attempted conquest of Qumis and the entire southern Caspian coast by Farhad Khan. However, this endevour was cut short with the escalation with the Beghdilids and only the first goal of the campaign could be accomplished -  the conquest of the Qumis Khanate.
